findings.text: Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.
Accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 31 December 2025 and the next accounts are due 30 June 2027.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 1 November 2025 and the next is due 15 November 2026.
The company has 92 outstanding, 0 part-satisfied and 8 satisfied charges registered, out of 308 in total; only the first 100 charges were fetched.
The register lists 10 current officers, including 9 directors, though only 100 of 120 officer records were fetched so some current officers may be missing.
One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1815, a company holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights, with the right to appoint and remove directors.
Since 24 October 2025, PERSON 421, a director, resigned on 6 May 2026, and no registered office address changes were filed.
Across the first 5 of 9 current directors checked, 2 other active companies were found, excluding this company.
